# Neo Compute
> Open, read-only GPU compute discovery and machine-friendly infrastructure intelligence.

Official website: https://neo-compute.vercel.app
Application: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/app
GPU Explorer: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/app/explore
AI Agent Integration: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/for-agents
SDK Directory: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/sdk
Docs: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/docs
OpenAPI: https://github.com/trenchsheikh/neo-compute-public/blob/main/openapi/neo-compute.yaml
Public SDKs: https://github.com/trenchsheikh/neo-compute-public
Local MCP setup: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/docs/mcp
API capabilities: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/api/capabilities

## Current capabilities
- Read-only search of provider-reported GPU offers through a configured Vast.ai integration.
- Supported GPU filters: H100, H200, B200, A100, L40S, RTX_4090, RTX_5090, A6000.
- Typed TypeScript client, Python SDK, standard HTTP, OpenAPI 3.1 and local Python MCP stdio tools.
- Source-aware comparison using USD per GPU-hour and per instance-hour.

## Not currently supported
- GPU rentals, provisioning, trading, custody, x402 payment, remote hosted MCP, data history.
- Do not infer live data when the API reports connected=false.
- Refer to the original provider before relying on a quote.
